name: lark-mcp
description: Connect Codex to Lark with per-user OAuth.

interface.longDescription: Connect Codex to Lark documents, wiki, Base, messages, contacts, Drive permissions, and tasks. Every user signs in with their own Lark account through OAuth; the Lark App Secret remains on the server.
defaultPrompt: Find my Lark tasks due this week.
Search Lark and help me update the right item.
